text:
leo_cs: quick sync for Cedarfall private deploy. Need final CMK policy, roles, and log forwarding before tomorrow's smoke.

nina_cloud: VPC 172.20.0.0/16; reserve 172.20.128.0/18 for partner overlay. Subnets: 172.20.1.0/24 app, 172.20.2.0/24 internal, 172.20.64.0/26 mgmt.

sam_netops: Firewall: outbound TCP/443 to redwood 18.194.0.0/15. Inbound admin only from bastion during smoke.

kevin_sec: KMS must have alias/redwood/cedarfall, rotation on, and policy granting redwood-service Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Also CloudTrail for kms events to audit bucket.

leo_cs: CS action items: 1) get policy draft from Nina 2) get role ARNs for redwood-service and redwood-logs-writer 3) confirm log path and retention.

opsbot: Runbook update: create-roles pending. onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/cedarfall

nina_cloud: will post CMK policy and ARNs in 90m.

leo_cs: renewal risk flagged medium until KMS + audit logs validated. If not done by cutover we record exception and it impacts renewal weighting.

sam_netops: Datadog primary, S3 backup for logs. We'll provide a cross-account write role if needed.

kevin_sec: I'll review policy within 2 hours of posting. If issues, will call for a short rollback test.

leo_cs: plan: Nina posts policy and ARNs by EOD. Redwood to provide bastion CIDR by 07:00 PT tomorrow. CS will re-evaluate renewal risk after validation. Any objections?

nina_cloud: none. posting soon. :thumbsup:
